counties.notes: Charleston County (pop. 430,000; includes Charleston, North Charleston, Mount Pleasant). Parcels live on GIS_VIEWER/New_Parcel_Search/MapServer layer 4. Field names are unqualified (PID, OWNER1, ...); the FEATURES.SDE.* prefixes an older revision of this entry described no longer apply, and neither GPIN nor ACRES_CAL exists here. Layer 4 carries 27 fields, including several the registry does not map: ACREAGE, CLASS_CODE, DEED_BOOK_PAGE, PLAT_BOOK_PAGE, SALE_PRICE, RECORDED_DATE and DOC_DATE. WATCH THIS COUNTY: it has now renumbered its parcel layer twice. 2026-06-06 moved Parcel_Search/4 to New_Parcel_Search/61 after the old service 404'd; 2026-09-17 moved it again to New_Parcel_Search/4, which is why the endpoint sat down with last_ok_at null. Both times the service name and the field names survived and only the layer index changed, so an index-only drift check would catch the next one.
